name: Nordreth Frame 171 Original
description: This listing is an impact-damped rehearsal loft listed with floor area 116 square metres, noise floor 23 dBA, occupancy 19 people. Its remaining stated figures are session length 3 hours, session fee set after acceptance, isolation method double-shell air gap. Every one of them is quoted from the same six axes the other listings in this category are described on.

reviews.title: Does what it says: floor area 116 square metres
reviews.text: Went through the whole impact-damped rehearsal loft catalogue twice before this listing. We needed a floor area around 116 square metres and this one states exactly that. The other impact-damped rehearsal loft listings are close to this listing on everything but floor area.

reviews.title: Better than what we ran before this listing

reviews.title: Where this listing falls short
reviews.text: This listing was not the cheapest impact-damped rehearsal loft we considered, and that was fine. This listing shipped without the mounting hardware we had assumed was included. None of that would stop us buying this listing again.
